download.title: Get the Browser Extension
download.description: The extension is open-source and self-hosted; build it from the repository (see EXTENSION.md)
download.tip: 💡 After building, follow the steps below to install and configure the API Key. Only Chrome/Chromium is supported (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, 360, QQ, Sogou, etc.)

popup.title: Popup Permission
popup.description: Allow TMarks to open popups to use the "Open All Tabs" feature.
popup.step1: 1. Click the TMarks extension icon in the toolbar.
popup.step2: 2. In the popup, go to the "Tab Groups" view and click "Open All Tabs".
popup.step3: 3. When the browser blocks the popup, click the address bar popup-block icon.
popup.step4: 4. Select "Always allow popups from this site" and click Done.

install.title: Installation Steps
install.description: Follow these steps to install the browser extension
install.step1Desc: Clone the repository and run pnpm --filter @tmarks/tab build; output lands in apps/tab/dist
install.step2Desc: Open chrome://extensions (or edge://extensions) in your browser
install.step3Desc: Toggle "Developer mode" in the top-right corner
install.step5Desc: Open the extension options and paste your API Key from Settings
install.step6Desc: Click the puzzle icon in the toolbar and pin TMarks

faq.title: FAQ
faq.iconNotFound: Q: Can't find the extension icon after installation?
faq.iconNotFoundAnswer: A: Click the puzzle icon on the right side of browser toolbar, find TMarks extension and click the pin button to show it in toolbar.
faq.howToGetApiKey: Q: How to get API Key?
faq.howToGetApiKeyAnswer: A: Create a new API Key in the "API" tab of General Settings and copy it to the extension configuration.
faq.supportedBrowsersAnswer: A: Only the Chrome/Chromium version is provided. It works on Chromium-based browsers like Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, 360, QQ and Sogou.
faq.whereToView: Where to view saved tab groups?
faq.whereToViewAnswer: View and manage all saved tab groups on the "Tab Groups" page of TMarks website.
